name: What's the difference between wainscoting and wall paneling?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between wainscoting and wall paneling?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, wainscoting is a specific type of wall paneling that covers only the lower portion of a wall. Wall paneling, in its broader definition, can refer to any decorative panels that cover an entire wall or section of a wall, not just the bottom. Wainscoting's distinct characteristic is its height, typically extending one-third to half-way up the wall, serving both decorative and protective purposes for the lower wall section.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wainscoting is a specific type of wall paneling that covers only the lower portion of a wall, while general wall paneling can cover entire walls.
